description: A WPF developer added WinUI 2 XamlControlsResources to App.xaml and got a namespace error, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62541270/the-tag-xamlcontrolsresources-does-not-exist-in-xml-namespace-usingmicrosoft.
prompt: I tried to use WinUI controls in my WPF app and added the Microsoft.UI.Xaml package. App.xaml now fails with: The tag 'XamlControlsResources' does not exist in XML namespace 'using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls'. What did I wire up wrong?
